name: date-picker
description: Native date field with an ISO-string contract, min/max passthrough and an optional clear button.
designIntent: A custom calendar is a large accessibility surface. The platform date picker already handles locale formatting, keyboard editing and mobile wheels, so DatePicker standardizes the ISO contract and a clear affordance instead of reimplementing a calendar.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fired with the ISO string; '' when cleared.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button once a value exists.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the clear button.

examples.title: ISO date field
examples.description: Controlled ISO value with a clear button.

antiPatterns.title: Don't store locale-formatted strings
antiPatterns.explanation: The contract is YYYY-MM-DD; format for display at the edge.

accessibility.implementation: Renders input[type=date] so OS pickers and keyboard editing apply
accessibility.userRequirements: Always provide a label (FormField or aria-label)
